scope: Generated same-line !define, paired documents/directive placement, shared authored/expanded lexical ownership, typed family headers, preamble/regions/styles/skinparams, complete sequence declarations/messages/arrows/notes/nested frames/lifecycle, and scoped state declarations/composites/descriptions/transitions with preserved models/layout and structured expanded-byte failures. Separate generated mindmap/WBS markers, files paths/raw notes and board stage rows construct the preserved Mindmap, Wbs, Files and Board models. Generated class/object/description/ArchiMate declarations, members, groups, names, aliases and relations preserve the UML model. Generated structured activity instructions, nested control blocks and raw actions preserve the activity model. Generated timing tracks/cursors/exact integers/connections and Gantt project/date/task/alias/duration/reference grammar preserve their models. Other family grammars and Creole remain pending. Complete Chen owners/composites/associations/cardinalities and EOF preserve Chen qualified identities with contextual keyword names. Generated JSON objects/arrays/members/numbers and literal HCL named blocks/headers/fields/containers construct the preserved ordered Value and Document before unchanged data lowering/layout. Generated PlantUML-specific YAML offside map/list/entry and narrow flow productions construct ordered string Value models; primitive capability, tab, quote, comment and literal ownership remains lexical. Generated Salt table/row/column/cell/widget syntax preserves postorder arenas, direct lexical escapes and same-row spans.
authorship: Original native parser infrastructure and generated subset grammars. Retained immutable evaluator, typed preamble/style policy, sequence participant/message/note/frame/lifecycle semantics and scoped two-phase state identity/resolution are traced to authorized MIT sources in plantuml-mit-1.2026.9.json, with original copyright/grant notices retained.
